text:
anya: dropped a new prototype for the 'snapshot details' modal in Figma — sharing because we need to resolve the a11y/focus flow before handoff: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC (internal). main questions: 1) primary focus target (heading vs first action), 2) how to avoid the timeline live-region doubling the announcement, 3) motion & focus-return timing. quick takes?
sam: prefer heading focus with role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". heading-first lets screen-reader users get context immediately. add aria-describedby to the short summary paragraph so VO reads a concise description.
lucas: agree heading-first. for the duplicate announcements, timeline currently has aria-live="assertive" which is the culprit. can we change timeline to polite and make the modal summary assertive only when it contains an important change? or simpler: suppress the timeline via inert/aria-hidden while modal open. my vote: inert background.
maria: inert is good but note cross-browser polyfill needed. alternative hybrid: timeline aria-hidden=true + keep inert for focusables. also store triggering element id so we can restore focus reliably. Recommend data attribute: data-snapshot-trigger="true" on the pill.
anya: noted. what about the heading text? tradeoff between exact label ("Snapshot v4") vs contextual ("Snapshot details â€” v4") to avoid verbatim repeats from timeline readout.
sam: use "Snapshot details â€” v4". SR will then read it as context. keep the visible pill label short. provide full phrase in aria-label on the trigger if needed.
lucas: CTA copy: avoid long buttons on narrow widths. primary could be "Rewind" with aria-label="Rewind to snapshot v4". secondary: "Abort canary" only when canary is active. we should include a copy-state table in the handoff.
maria: accessibility edge case: if modal is opened by keyboard while user is in virtualized timeline, the triggering DOM node may not be focusable or might be recycled. fallback: capture document.activeElement before opening, and on close attempt to focus it; if not available, find [data-snapshot-trigger] else focus on the timeline container. include a 60ms delay after close if we animate.
anya: putting the snippet in the dev notes.
````
// capture focus
const lastFocused = document.activeElement;
openSnapshotModal();
// on close
closeSnapshotModal();
setTimeout(() => {
  (lastFocused && lastFocused.focus && document.contains(lastFocused))
    ? lastFocused.focus()
    : document.querySelector('[data-snapshot-trigger]')?.focus();
}, 60);
````
sam: motion & reduced-motion: prefer fade 100ms in, 70ms out. but respect prefers-reduced-motion and use no animation. also avoid moving focus while animation runs. delay return-focus until after animation completes.
lucas: visual focus ring lost in Firefox on the pill when using outline-offset; make sure we test in FF and Chromium. also snapshot stat color contrast is 2.9:1 currently; should be >=3.0 for small text or bump weight.
maria: i'll update figma: heading-first focus, aria-describedby id, aria-live strategy (modal-local polite/atomic for stats), copy-state table, reduced-motion notes, and dev snippet. also adding a 50-80ms focus-return window tied to the close animation.
anya: on suppressing timeline announcements: timeline should switch to aria-hidden while modal is active. we must ensure hidden content is removed from AT tree (inert polyfill). if polyfill lacks support, fallback to aria-hidden + set tabindex=-1 on child focusables. add tests for NVDA + VoiceOver.
sam: test matrix: VO (mac), NVDA (windows), JAWS (windows), TalkBack (android) for basic flow. record one quick screen recording of VO reading on open/close so we can confirm no double reads. assignable task in Jira: UXA-9210.
a11y-bot: Accessibility item created: A11Y-8001  Snapshot modal: focus-trap, background inertness, live-region handling, focus-return timing (assignees: sam, lucas).
anya: UX question: should the modal summary include an aria-live region for canary traffic % updates while open? if yes, keep it aria-atomic=true and polite.
lucas: yes but keep the live region scoped to the percentage element only to avoid re-reading the whole modal. use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true" on that span.
maria: css/accessibility nit: add a brief pulse/spotlight animation on the triggering pill for 500ms after close so keyboard users visually reconnect to origin. purely presentation class, no DOM changes. devs okay with that?
sam: fine. implement via class toggle. ensure it's turned off for prefers-reduced-motion.
anya: i'll update Figma and the handoff doc now, including the required aria attributes and the copy table for states. will ping a11y-bot when ready for review. thanks all :sparkles:
